items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So he came over and brought his guitar and we played some together and everything.

ctx.x: …and have a good personality, and they’d be in…

Personality helps, too, ‘cause you… (laughs) I told you, you have a fight with somebody and then you gotta sit next to them in a car for three hours. (laughs) So… And there’s a, there’s a Brazilian guitar player that I met in Europe this last time. He was accompanying… I forget… a terrific lady, Brazilian singer. Lubamba is his last name. I have a CD of his. He came over to the apartment. Fantastic. Brazilians. They’re disgusting. And he’s a lovely guy. He lives in New Jersey now. And… So he came over and brought…
Anybody that you can think of that you’ve never played with that you would want to, dead or alive, I mean…?
